In a daze,

Chikun Main Star, Thirteen Peaks.

Deep within the grand hall, Lin Yuan slowly opened his eyes.

“Six hundred years… In the blink of an eye….”

Lin Yuan’s gaze rippled as scenes from his experiences in the Tianqing World flashed through his mind, and then settled back into calmness.

...

For someone like the Chikun Star Lord, who had lived for hundreds of thousands of years, six hundred years might just be a small nap.

Even for his significantly younger senior brothers, First, Second, and Third, it might just be like closing their eyes for one meditation session, or the time it takes to practice a secret technique?

But for Lin Yuan, it was already a protracted period. Even if adding in the previous times he had traveled, six hundred years made up a substantial proportion of the total time.

“Sigh…”

Lin Yuan looked around.

“The world has changed….”

Lin Yuan’s eyes were serene,

After comprehending more than a thousand core spatial models,

Lin Yuan could now see the ‘ripples’ caused by the fluctuations of countless forces of space everywhere his sight touched.

If the Tianqing World was a small pond,

for every ‘ripple,’ Lin Yuan could trace back to the source and see the end,

everything was within his control.

Then the Cosmic Starry Sky of the Main World was like a vast ocean,

any single spatial ‘ripple’ could spread and affect places extremely far away,

and even if Lin Yuan strained his eyes, he could only see a small part of the fluctuations.

“Different size of worlds, different perceptions and feelings.”

Lin Yuan appeared thoughtful,

He clearly felt that, upon returning to the Main World,

the bottleneck restraint he faced when contemplating the core spatial models,

if not entirely swept away, had dissipated for the most part.

“Let’s not worry about these for now.”

“Let’s check on the connection between the Door to the Myriad Realms and the Tianqing World.”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts converged, his spirit delving into his mind, looking towards that towering and majestic Door to the Myriad Realms.

In the last two hundred years in the Tianqing World, Lin Yuan had abandoned everything else, focusing all his energy on establishing a method to replace the World’s Consciousness.

Such action was naturally not just to control the Tianqing World.

If it were about controlling the Tianqing World, Lin Yuan really didn’t need to bother so much. With the strength of the initial Ancestral Demon Tree, who would dare not to obey where his will went?

Lin Yuan’s true goal was to transform the Tianqing World into a backyard and, from there, to entertain thoughts about the Boundless Outer Void outside of the Tianqing World.

Hum.

Lin Yuan carefully observed the area below the Door to the Myriad Realms.

He saw that behind the marks of the six world coordinates, a seventh world coordinate mark was faintly forming,

It was indeed the world coordinate of the Tianqing World.

Lin Yuan watched the Tianqing World coordinate, and bits of information began to flood into his mind.

“As expected.”

“Now, choosing to descend in the Tianqing World, the consumption of World-Breaking Origin Force is only one-third of a strand?”

Lin Yuan was pleased in his heart.

This precise descent into a world by using world coordinates consumes ten strands of the World-Breaking Origin Force.

And now, it’s only one-third of a strand, clearly indicating that the Tianqing World was no longer resistant to Lin Yuan’s consciousness, and even actively welcoming it, greatly saving the consumption of the World-Breaking Origin Force.

“One-third of a strand of World-Breaking Origin Force is just over ninety days in the Main World…”

A smile emerged on Lin Yuan’s face.

The normal time it takes for the Door to the Myriad Realms to accumulate one strand of World-Breaking Origin Force is three hundred thirty-three days.

With the enhancement of the Eternal Spatial Rift, it only takes two hundred ninety days for one strand.

“Also, through the world coordinates on the Door to the Myriad Realms, am I vaguely able to receive many messages from the Ancestral Demon Tree?”

Lin Yuan suddenly sensed something.

The Ancestral Demon Tree has now become the new World Consciousness of the Tianqing World, that is, the ‘Heavenly Tao.’

And the Ancestral Demon Tree is merely a vessel for Lin Yuan, quite similar to an Avatar, theoretically, they should share the same consciousness and memory.

However,

because the Main World and the Tianqing World are in the Boundless Void so far apart from each other,

not even in the same dimension, not in the same tier, and even the flow of time is vastly different,

the perceptive connection between Lin Yuan and the Ancestral Demon Tree was utterly severed.

But through the Door to the Myriad Realms, they were somehow barely establishing a weak connection?

“I didn’t expect the Door to the Myriad Realms to have this use too?”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face; through this faint connection, he roughly knew the state of the Tianqing World, and so the timing of his descent would be more precise.

Even if the current consumption to descend into the Tianqing World is only one-third of a strand of World-Breaking Origin Force, even if it were one-tenth of a strand, it is still World-Breaking Origin Force and shouldn’t be wasted carelessly.

…

Having confirmed the connection with the Tianqing World,

Lin Yuan then turned his attention to himself.

“Shall we take a look at the Inner World?”

With a slight movement of his thoughts, Lin Yuan’s consciousness descended into his Inner World.

Before the sixth traversal, Lin Yuan’s Inner World was only ten miles in circumference.

But now,

As Lin Yuan’s consciousness descended,

many insights into the Space Rules merged,

Boom boom boom.

The Inner World welcomd a massive change.

At the world’s edge, countless forces of space converged, space vibrated, and the world’s limits rapidly rose.

Leading to…

Lin Yuan once again fell into a kind of insane hunger.

Upon stepping into the Seventh Rank, and starting to carve out his Inner World, Lin Yuan had this feeling,

But at that time, he had prepared enough Red Spirit Fluid, so the creation of the Inner World went extremely smoothly.

But now…

“Hold on, wait a second…”

Lin Yuan hastily suppressed the expansion of his Inner World, for with his current understanding of the Space Rules, the ultimate limit of his Inner World at the very least would span ten thousand miles.

Ten miles in circumference versus ten thousand miles or more is not a simple increase by thousands of times; the demand for energy is terrifying.

If Lin Yuan didn’t suppress it, he might be drained dry.
